data.title: Microsoft declares internal ‘Code Red’ after historic 24-hour outage - Reuters By Investing.com
data.summary: Investing.com -- Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has initiated an internal "Code Red" mobilization to overhaul its engineering protocols and crisis response systems following a historic 24-hour service outage earlier this month, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters. The urgent operational directive underscores heightened executive scrutiny over the reliability of the tech giant’s enterprise cloud infrastructure after the disruption. [...] Microsoft attributed the failure to an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July rather than cyber activity or autonomous AI agents. During a subsequent internal review, Executive Vice President Charles Lamanna noted that the compromised component had absorbed "roughly ten years' worth of acceptable failures," highlighting the severity of the architectural strain. [...] The November 12–13 incident knocked out core workplace applications, including Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant, impacting governments and businesses across the world. In a Friday memo to staff, M365 Core President Jason Henderson described the event as the most customer-impacting incident in the history of Exchange Online, adding that the Code Red designation makes remediation the team's highest priority.
